== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Asajj Ventress With Lightsabers (Errata)]]: the PC card image of [[Asajj Ventress With Lightsabers]] (3 January 2023, [[:File:VP-D-asajjventresswithlightsabers.gif|VP-D-asajjventresswithlightsabers.gif]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (page 1). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
